findings.body: The branch only records that DEPLOY started; it delivers none of item 10. The skeleton contains no Dockerfile, and `src/forge/init.py:88–89` copies that skeleton into new repositories. `src/forge/templates/conventions/stack.md:22–31` still specifies `apps/api` and `apps/web` without the required frontend/backend build, serve, migration and readiness contract, and there is no deploy conventions page. Add the Dockerfile and conventions so a new client repository can build the frontend, serve it through the backend, and start serving only after migrations succeed.
